pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take:
**Devin, your chaos-loving squad outplaying Gunner's French misfire is proof that even Ghost Pepper understands preparation!**

Let me tell you something. When Spain thumped France 2-0, Devin was not just collecting points — he was schooling you, Bubba G, in the art of drafting. Spain over France? A masterclass in foresight. But don't think for one second, Ghost Pepper, that this makes you invincible. You might be sitting on top with 92 points, but let's face it, drafting Bosnia? That's like betting on a llama in the Kentucky Derby. Mustard Boy, Zach, I'm coming at you next. Fourth place with Brazil in your pocket? You couldn't manage a lemonade stand in a heatwave, let alone a World Cup pool. And Rafe, "The Noisemaker," if you're thinking your current spot in the standings is some kind of cunning strategy — kid, when Germany can’t save you from last place, it’s time to join a book club instead of a World Cup pool. You all claim to know the beautiful game, but right now, only Devin's got the grit, and the rest of you are just playing dress-up. Mic dropped.

pundit_takes.headline: Devin Establishes Commanding Lead As Spain Dismantles France
pundit_takes.subtitle: "I guess drafting actual contenders is a thing," says Ghost Pepper.

pundit_takes.headline: Gayden's England Set To Face Argentina In Tactical Showdown
pundit_takes.subtitle: Hopes his son Rafe learns there are other teams to draft.

pundit_takes.headline: Zach Remains Low On Points Despite Brazil's Drafting Power
pundit_takes.subtitle: "Maybe it's not just about the mustard," quips Mustard Boy.

pundit_takes.headline: Rafe Sinks To Last Place, Still Wins Best Underdog Draft
pundit_takes.subtitle: Picked three teams that didn't qualify, yet somehow earned 29 points.
